review_candidates.title: Sr Technical Solution Manager
review_candidates.description: Overview Commercial Engineering & AI (CEAI) partners closely with stakeholders to accelerate the transformation of Microsoft’s commercial business into a frontier organization. We bring together AI‑native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to reimagine how work gets done - at scale and with impact. Our mission is to unlock new ways of operating through intelligent systems while creating the conditions for our teams to do the most meaningful work of their careers. If you’re excited to build, experiment, and shape the future of commercial execution with AI at the core, we invite you to apply. As part of CEAI, the Support Experience Group (SxG) is leading the transformation of Microsoft’s support ecosystem into an AI-first, agent-powered model. We build intelligent platforms and reusable AI agents that diagnose, guide, and resolve customer issues—improving time-to-resolution and enabling engineers to focus on complex, high-value scenarios. We are looking for a Sr Technical Solution Manager to us AI to drive the implementation of Business Continuity / Dial Tone solution for our customer support ecosystem to ensure our critical support infrastructure is available when our customers need us most. This role will work with business and engineering team to define the Business Continuity Disaster Recovery (BCDR) scenarios and requirements and drive implementation. They will develop and maintain BCDR playbooks so all roles across the company know what to do during an outage. They will also conduct periodic outage drills to ensure all people, process, and technology is ready at a moments notice. Responsibilities Build cross-team coordination and community across business and engineering teams to solve complex business-process and technology-integration challenges and deliver technical solutions. Develop vision, strategy, and roadmap for complex, high-impact solution areas aligned with business, security, and compliance objectives, incorporating emerging-technology research and proof-of-concept evaluations. Garner stakeholder support and buy-in for the solution vision and strategy; clarify requirements, communicate priorities, and translate complex problem statements into business requirements for engineering teams. Partner with engineering teams to design roadmaps and develop technical solutions that meet business, technical, and compliance needs. Track and communicate project schedules end-to-end; hold stakeholders accountable, manage risks, and allocate resources effectively. Define success criteria and performance metrics; use KPIs and OKRs, success metrics, and Voice of Customer feedback to consolidate status updates and evaluate and resolve solution performance issues. Drive adoption and continuous improvement; conduct user acceptance testing and focus groups, enable and train stakeholders/partners on changes, and mature solutions post-launch by addressing feedback. This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. review_candidates.title: Lead Enterprise Salesforce Architect
review_candidates.description: Become a part of our caring community Join our innovative team as a Lead Solution Architect and play a pivotal role in transforming healthcare technology through enterprise-scale Salesforce solutions. You will lead the design, integration, and implementation of cutting-edge digital platforms leveraging Salesforce Health Cloud, Service Cloud, MuleSoft, APIs, microservices, and Azure cloud technologies. In this strategic leadership role, you will drive initiatives that improve patient engagement, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. If you are passionate about digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and delivering scalable healthcare solutions, we want to hear from you. The Lead Solution Architect is responsible for defining end-to-end solution architecture, technology strategy, and integration patterns for enterprise applications and digital platforms. This role leads the design and implementation of Salesforce-centric solutions while ensuring alignment with business objectives, enterprise architecture standards, and healthcare compliance requirements. The architect will evaluate business needs, define scalable solution architectures, and ensure seamless integration across Salesforce, Azure, enterprise applications, and healthcare systems. This position influences organizational technology strategy, drives architecture governance, and provides leadership across complex initiatives with significant technical and business impact. Key Responsibilities Lead the solution architecture and technical design of enterprise applications with a focus on: Salesforce Health Cloud Salesforce Service Cloud MuleSoft API-led connectivity Azure Cloud Microservices-based architectures Define scalable, secure, and high-performing Salesforce solution architectures that align with enterprise and business objectives. Design integration strategies between Salesforce and enterprise platforms, including healthcare applications, data platforms, ERP systems, and third-party services. Establish architecture standards, best practices, governance models, and implementation frameworks for Salesforce and enterprise solutions. Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, engineering teams, and executive leadership to align technology investments with strategic goals. Lead architecture reviews, solution assessments, and technology evaluations to drive innovation and continuous improvement. Ensure compliance with healthcare industry regulations, security standards, data privacy requirements, and interoperability frameworks. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent work experience. 10+ years of experience in enterprise application development, solution architecture, or technology leadership roles. 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce architecture experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale solutions. Experience leading cross-functional teams, architecture governance processes, and large-scale implementation programs. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Prior experience serving as a Lead Architect, Enterprise Architect, or Solution Architect for large transformation initiatives. Experience implementing Salesforce Health Cloud or other healthcare-focused Salesforce solutions. Strong understanding of healthcare data standards and interoperability frameworks including: HL7 FHIR HIPAA Healthcare compliance and privacy regulations Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, platform governance, and cloud-native application architectures. Knowledge of AI, Agentforce, Salesforce Data Cloud, and customer engagement platforms. Proven ability to influence business and technology strategy through architecture leadership and innovation.
